name: How long does it take to repair or replace a bathroom door frame?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair or replace a bathroom door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most minor bathroom door frame repairs take two to four hours, whereas a full frame replacement usually takes between half a day and a full day. The process begins with removing the trim and assessing hidden moisture damage. Once the jamb is rebuilt or swapped, the technician plumbs the frame, re-hangs the door, installs new casing, and caulks all joints. If water-resistant paint or wood filler needs curing time between coats, the project may extend into a second day before final cleanup and touch-ups are complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor frame repairs take about two to four hours, while removing and replacing an entire door frame typically requires four to eight hours.
